summary: Computer Agents is an agentic compute platform that gives each AI agent a persistent cloud computer with a browser, terminal, files, and deployment tools. Each agent runs in its own isolated cloud container with strict resource and access boundaries, and work persists across sessions in a shared workspace. It is used by teams running agents that research, build, and operate products and workflows end to end.
